summary: Lead research for SBDC Educational Resources MVP (small business development educational content platform). Targets Ohio SBDC offices, community colleges, entrepreneurship programs, and small business training providers that could benefit from centralized educational resources and training materials.

leads.organization: Ohio Small Business Development Centers (Statewide Network)
leads.fit_rationale: Leading resource for Ohio entrepreneurs offering no-cost consulting and training. Centralized educational resources platform would standardize and enhance training delivery across all centers.
Ashtabula-based nonprofit focused on entrepreneurial education since 2011. Educational resources platform would complement their workshops and peer support groups.
Offers B.B.A. in Entrepreneurship combining classroom learning with real-world experience. Educational resources platform would support their curriculum and student ventures.
Offers Entrepreneurship undergraduate certificate and hands-on programs. Local SBDC educational resources would benefit their students and the broader community.
Promotes business education through scholarships, mentorship, and information sharing. Educational resources platform would support their mission to educate the business community.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add searchable resource library with filters by topic, business stage, and industry.
Include downloadable templates and toolkits (business plans, financial models, marketing templates).
Create video tutorial library with captioning and transcripts.
Add interactive workshops and webinars with registration management.
Provide learning paths for different entrepreneur types (startup, growth, expansion).
Include success stories and case studies from local businesses.
Add assessment tools to identify knowledge gaps and recommend resources.
Create discussion forums for peer learning and networking.

possible_issues: Educational resource sites need clear organization—poor categorization makes finding content difficult.
Without modern, professional design, credibility with business owners may suffer.
Missing mobile optimization limits access for entrepreneurs researching on phones.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Educational resource platforms are highly white-labelable for different SBDC centers, community colleges, or economic development organizations with custom branding.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
Contact Ohio SBDC state office about centralized educational resources.
Reach out to Kent State Ashtabula about partnership opportunities.
Explore integration with NEO Fund's existing educational programs.
